concept.name: Fujiya Ramen
concept.tagline: Japanese ramen and more in Shadyside, Pittsburgh

menu.name: Tonkotsu Ramen
menu.description: Rich pork bone broth with chashu pork, soft-boiled egg, scallions, and noodles.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of tonkotsu ramen with creamy pork broth, sliced chashu pork, a halved soft-boiled egg, and green scallions, sealed with a clear lid and paper bag on a plain surface.

menu.name: Shoyu Ramen
menu.description: Soy-based chicken and pork broth with chashu, bamboo shoots, nori, and noodles.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of shoyu ramen with clear brown soy broth, sliced chashu, bamboo shoots, and a sheet of nori, with a paper bag and chopsticks beside it.

menu.name: Miso Ramen
menu.description: Miso-seasoned broth with corn, bean sprouts, ground pork, and noodles.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of miso ramen with golden broth, corn kernels, bean sprouts, and ground pork on wavy noodles, in a sealed takeout box.

menu.name: Spicy Miso Ramen
menu.description: Miso ramen with chili oil, ground pork, and a spicy kick.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of spicy miso ramen with red chili oil swirled into orange broth, ground pork and scallions on top, sealed for takeout.

menu.name: Chicken Katsu Don
menu.description: Breaded fried chicken cutlet over rice with egg and sweet soy sauce.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of chicken katsu don with a crispy breaded chicken cutlet over rice, egg, and sauce, with a plastic fork and lid.

menu.name: Gyoza
menu.description: Pan-fried pork dumplings served with dipping sauce.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout box of pan-fried pork gyoza with golden bottoms, next to a small cup of dipping sauce, in a sealed takeout container.

menu.name: Vegetable Ramen
menu.description: Vegetable broth ramen with tofu, mushrooms, corn, and bok choy.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout container of vegetable ramen with clear broth, tofu cubes, mushrooms, corn, and bok choy over noodles, sealed for takeout.

menu.name: Matcha Ice Cream
menu.imagePrompt: A small takeout cup of pale green matcha ice cream with a wooden spoon, on a plain background.

brand.logoPrompt: A simple flat two-color mark combining a steaming ramen bowl with chopsticks forming the letter F, in deep red on cream.
brand.voice: Friendly, direct, and welcoming, like a neighborhood ramen counter where the staff are happy to explain the bowl.
